title: Recovery of Singapore Exchange's Reputation after Recent Technical Glitches and Doubts over Quality of Listings
what_it_is: Recovery of Singapore Exchange's Reputation after Recent Technical Glitches and Doubts over Quality of Listings

sections.label: Global IPO decline and SGX challenges
sections.summary: Global IPO activity has declined, private financing markets compete with public exchanges, and SGX faces low liquidity and poorly performing counters.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Globally, there has been a significant decline in Initial Public Offering (IPO) activity, including in markets like the United States and Hong Kong.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The rise of alternative private financing markets, offering comparable scale and pricing, also poses increasing competition to public stock exchanges globally.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: There are other challenges faced by SGX more particularly, such as low levels of liquidity and many poorly performing counters.

sections.label: Mainboard listing entry bar raised
sections.summary: The entry bar for companies seeking to list on the mainboard has been raised.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The entry bar for companies seeking to list on the mainboard has been raised.

sections.label: SGX regulatory functions transfer plan
sections.summary: In July, SGX announced plans to transfer its regulatory functions to a subsidiary with a separate independent board.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In July, SGX announced plans to transfer its regulatory functions to a subsidiary company, which will focus exclusively on the task and would be governed by a separate and independent board.

sections.label: IPO activity increased first half
sections.summary: IPO activity increased in the first half of this year compared to the same period last year.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: IPO activity has increased in the first half of this year, compared to the same period last year.

sections.label: SGX explained July disruption
sections.summary: After the 14 July disruption, SGX explained the technical issues within five days by 19 July and took it seriously.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The Member would recall that when the disruption happened on 14 July, within five days, by 19 July, SGX came out, explained what the technical issues were that led to the breakdown and took it very seriously.

sections.label: SGX pockets doing well, IPO listings
sections.summary: Some parts of SGX are doing well, with 16 listings in the first half of this year compared to 11 last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Within SGX, I would say that there are pockets that are still doing very well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I mentioned in my reply earlier that in the first half of this year, IPO activity went up more than last year – 16 listings in the first half of this year compared to 11 last year.

sections.label: MAS fine option for SGX
sections.summary: After the July 2016 incident, observers expected MAS might consider imposing a fine on SGX.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: When this recent incident happened in July 2016, there were observers expecting that MAS might consider the option of imposing a fine on SGX.

sections.label: MAS view of technical disruption
sections.summary: MAS takes the technical disruption very seriously.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As for the technical disruption, MAS takes it very seriously.

sections.label: Looking forward to resilient SGX
sections.summary: The speaker says it is more important to look forward to a resilient, responsive SGX system and not see another disruption.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I think it is much more important to look forward, to make sure that we have a resilient, responsive SGX system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We take it very seriously and we certainly do not want to see another one.
